name: Belmond Hotel Cipriani
insider_take: This legendary Venetian palazzo sits on its own private island of Giudecca, offering an exclusive escape from the crowds with unparalleled views of St. Mark's Square across the lagoon.
whats_special: The only hotel in Venice with a heated Olympic-size swimming pool, plus the original Bellini cocktail was invented here by Giuseppe Cipriani in 1948. The hotel's private boat service whisks guests directly to St. Mark's Square in just 3 minutes, while their Michelin-starred Oro Restaurant showcases innovative Venetian cuisine with panoramic lagoon views.
pro_tip: Book a Lagoon View room on higher floors for the most spectacular sunrise views over St. Mark's Basin, and time your arrival via the hotel's mahogany water taxi during golden hour for an unforgettable first impression.
dont_miss: Sunset aperitivos on the Giudecca Terrace with views of Doge's Palace, a morning swim in the legendary pool surrounded by manicured gardens, and exploring the nearby Redentore Church designed by Palladio - accessible via a peaceful 5-minute stroll through the charming Giudecca neighborhood.
pros: Exclusive private island location with stunning lagoon views
World-renowned Michelin-starred dining and celebrity chef restaurants
Iconic heated Olympic-size swimming pool with panoramic Venice views
Legendary impeccable service and attention to detail
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
Requires boat transfer to reach main Venice attractions
